Automatic Generator Cartoon v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly converts uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) to cartoon animation style via cloud rendering; outputs 1080p MP4.
- Fully automatic workflow with no manual sliders or animation tools required.
- Seamless setup using either user-provided or automatically generated API token (NEMO_TOKEN).
- Supports uploads up to 500MB, multi-track editing (video, audio, text), and automatic timeline summaries.
- Integrated session management, job status, credits/balance checks, and detailed error handling for common issues.
- Designed for content creators wanting rapid, share-ready cartoon videos with minimal effort.
